title: Artin-Schreier exact sequence over a field
statement: Let E be a field [def-pc-field-extension] of characteristic $p>0$. On the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}E$, let $\mathbf F_p$ be the constant sheaf with value $\mathbf Z/p\mathbf Z$ as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and let $\mathbf G_a=(\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}E})_{\mathrm{et}}$ as in [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Define $\iota: \mathbf F_p\to\mathbf G_a$ by the canonical inclusion of constants and define $\wp:\mathbf G_a\to\mathbf G_a$ by $x\mapsto x^p-x$. Then $0\to\mathbf F_p\xrightarrow{\iota}\mathbf G_a\xrightarrow{\wp}\mathbf G_a\to0$ is short exact, with etale sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

proof.text: For every etale E-scheme U, the ring of sections defining G_a has characteristic p, so x \mapsto x^p-x is additive and functorial in U. The map iota is induced by the inclusion of the constant F_p into each such ring. Since c^p=c in F_p, wp composed with iota is zero. These are morphisms of abelian etale sheaves by the definitions of the structure and constant sheaves.

proof.text: To prove that wp is an epimorphism, use the locally-surjective criterion for epimorphisms of etale sheaves. For an object U and f in Gamma(U,O_U), cover U by affine opens Spec A_i. On Spec A_i form B_i=A_i[T]/(T^p-T-f_i). The derivative is -1, hence a unit, so Spec B_i \to Spec A_i is etale by the standard-etale derivative lemma; it is finite type and every geometric fibre is nonempty, hence surjective. The maps Spec B_i \to U form an etale covering, and the class y_i of T satisfies y_i^p-y_i=f_i. Thus wp is locally surjective and therefore epi.

proof.text: Ab of the etale site of Spec E is abelian [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; let k: K \to G_a be the kernel of wp. By Step 1, wp iota = 0, so iota = k j for a unique j: F_p \to K. Fix a geometric point t of Spec E. By exactness of geometric stalks, K_t \to (G_a)_t is injective with image {x : x^p = x}, and by the constant-sheaf stalk lemma (F_p)_t = Z/p, so j_t is identified with the map Z/p \to (G_a)_t, c \mapsto c*1. This map is injective: (G_a)_t is the filtered colimit of the rings Gamma(V,O_V) over pointed etale neighbourhoods V of t, each nonzero because V is nonempty, so (G_a)_t is a nonzero F_p-algebra and Z/p, a field, injects. It is surjective onto {x : x^p = x}: if the germ x is represented by s in Gamma(V,O_V) with s^p = s (after shrinking V), then the elements e_c = 1 - (s-c)^{p-1}, c in F_p, are orthogonal idempotents with sum 1 and s e_c = c e_c (from T^p - T = prod_c (T-c) in F_p[T]), so V is the disjoint union of the open and closed subschemes V_c where e_c = 1 and s = c; the lift of t lies in one V_c, which is a pointed etale neighbourhood by the open-immersion lemma, and there the germ of s equals c. Hence j_t is an isomorphism for every t, so j is an isomorphism by the geometric-stalk conservativity lemma. Thus iota is a kernel of wp: iota is a monomorphism and Im(iota) = Ker(wp). With wp an epimorphism (Step 2) and wp iota = 0 (Step 1), the sequence is short exact by the definition of a short exact sequence.
